tests.method: Read current index.html, demo.css, demo.js, dist/tabuna.css without reports
tests.result: Actual Tabuna classes on heading, intro, editable sample, article, UI demo and table; outer labels/navigation use system-ui.

tests.method: Isolated localhost tab, 1280x720 screenshot; no shared viewport changes
tests.result: Hero and article hierarchy clear, 16px Russian body and checkbox/button visually legible without clipping. Save action changed the live status text.

tests.method: HTTP server log, rendered status and computed styles
tests.result: WOFF2 d07839f04ebdbfb89fed1c4f9d5d2609197db1071251bd5cf8ab0db5f626b207 returned HTTP 200; page says Tabuna Sans loaded. Target computed families select Tabuna Sans. Read-only browser document.fonts enumeration returned empty, so this is not per-glyph renderer identification.

Hero 149.76/152.755px w450; article heading 43.52/47.002px w500; body 16/26.4px w400; UI label 16/23.2px w400; button 16/23.2px w500; status 13/18.85px w400. Body preset is 18px w400/1.6, UI preset 16px w500/1.45.
Rem-based body/UI typography and responsive grids present. Hero nowrap/clamp and fixed-pixel interactive sample require actual 200%/400% checks; no such visual validation performed.

ui.reason: Readable actual 16px UI label/button and 13px status at inspected desktop size; broader form/dialog and enlargement coverage missing.

headings.reason: Current desktop hero and two-line Russian article heading show clean hierarchy and no clipping; pass limited to inspected size/weights.

body.reason: Current 16px/1.65 w400 Russian paragraphs visually readable; English paragraphs and longer text not exercised.

sustained_reading.reason: Brief visual inspection is not prolonged reading or human research; existing specimen is too short.

findings.condition: Approving UI use beyond the current checkbox/save sample
findings.evidence: Demo has one 16px checkbox label, one 16px medium button, one 13px status; the main controls and labels are system-ui. No dialog, input placeholder, error state or dense navigation in Tabuna.
findings.recommendation: Add a scoped Tabuna form and dialog sample with long Russian labels, help/error text and 12–14px dense controls.
findings.acceptance_test: Verify actual font on each field/button; inspect 12/13/14/16px, weights 400/500/600, long labels, disabled/error states and 200%/400% enlargement without clipping.

findings.evidence: Only two short Russian paragraphs in the article, with default 16px/1.65; no extended bilingual prose, semantic emphasis or long reading exercise.
findings.recommendation: Add several screenfuls of English and Russian prose at 16–18px with realistic headings, lists and emphasized spans.
findings.acceptance_test: Render at intended widths and sizes, inspect paragraph rhythm and line endings; obtain actual reading feedback before any fatigue/comprehension claim.

findings.condition: Shipping responsive/enlarged heading and form layouts
findings.evidence: Hero has white-space:nowrap and viewport/rem clamp; editable sample receives inline px sizes; source breakpoint rules alone do not prove enlarged reflow.
findings.recommendation: Run isolated 320px and 200%/400% zoom or text-enlargement validation. Attribute any container overflow to layout first.
findings.acceptance_test: All essential labels/buttons reachable, no clipped accent/descender, heading readable and no page-level horizontal scrolling at the tested enlargement settings.

limitations: Initial bounded independent review; no prior/current audit reports read.
No human participants, reading-speed, comprehension or fatigue measurements.
No pixel-level per-glyph font tracing; WOFF2 successful load and scoped styles corroborate use.
No small-screen, browser-zoom, dark-mode, Windows rasterization or native dialog rendering validated.
No confirmed font-outline defect found in this UI review; findings above concern evidence and demo coverage.
Automatic approval initially rejected broadly bound local server; corrected safer localhost-only bind was approved and used.
